programme.title: The Seven Year Itch
programme.desc: With his family away for their annual summer holiday, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) decides he has the opportunity to live a bachelor's life. The beautiful but ditsy blond (Marilyn Monroe) from the apartment above his catches his eye.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot
programme.desc: This hysterical comedy from director Billy Wilder finds Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon masquerading as women in order to elude irate Chicago mobsters while befriending a beautiful singer (Marilyn Monroe).

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: Braveheart

programme.title: Triple 9
programme.desc: When a bank-robbing crew of corrupt cops and ex-Special Forces must attempt a nearly impossible heist for a ruthless mobster, their only hope of survival is to distract the entire Atlanta police force with a “999” — cop code for “officer down.”

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: A group of medical researchers discover a way to bring dead patients back to life.

programme.title: Jessabelle

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: Carrie (2013)
programme.desc: Chloë Grace Moretz and Julianne Moore star in this exhilarating reimagining of Stephen King's iconic best-seller, 'Carrie.' After merciless taunting and abuse, events spiral out of control until the terrifying conclusion of this horror story.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Stephen King's A Good Marriage
programme.desc: With a serial killer on the loose and a stranger stalking her family, a dedicated wife unveils a sinister secret about her husband that threatens their marriage, and their lives.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story about a single father and his young son. Finding themselves homeless, he risks everything on an unpaid internship in a highly competitive stockbroker training program, where only one in twenty interns make the grade.

programme.title: Undisputed
programme.desc: When the world's heavyweight champion is sent to prison, everything points to an inevitable showdown with the penitentiary's undefeated champ. But to make sure the meeting will happen, a former mob boss must call in favors from the outside world.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Ip Man is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, the grandmaster of the Wing Chun style of kung fu and sifu of legendary martial arts superstar, Bruce Lee.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: In this explosive third installment of the blockbuster martial arts series, when a band of brutal gangsters led by crooked property developer (Mike Tyson) make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men
programme.desc: In this sequel to Grumpy Old Men, a vivacious Italian beauty attempts to convert Wabasha, Minnesota's cherished bait store into a romantic Italian restaurant.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind, or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: A comedy about a stunt man who’s never successfully landed a jump without wiping out and his attempt to master the biggest stunt of his life.

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: The story of a minor-league North Carolina baseball team (the Triple A Durham Bulls) and its attentive, intelligent groupie who feels it is her mission to live with one young player per season and help him mature.

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: The Tailor of Panama
programme.desc: Based on the 1996 novel, this is a mixture of thriller and black comedy. Harry Pendel is the tailor to the powerful of Panama. Harry is known for his storytelling and suits, but soon his tales carry lethal repercussions.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: As the entire nation watches the presidential campaign hurtle towards Election Day, one soldier races to uncover the conspiracy behind it - a conspiracy that seeks to destroy democracy itself.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: Mitch joins a prosperous Memphis firm that affords Mitch and his wife an affluent lifestyle beyond their wildest dreams. But when FBI agents confront him with evidence of corruption and murder within the firm, Mitch sets out to find the truth.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st airborne division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back, and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: The Host (2013)
programme.desc: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan

programme.title: The Great Raid

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: The Pit and the Pendulum (1961)

programme.title: The Fall Of The House Of Usher (1960)

programme.title: Dark Tide

Kate accepts a lucrative opportunity to lead a thrill-seeking millionaire businessman on a shark dive in the most dangerous waters, outside the cage.

programme.title: Hell House LLC.

programme.title: Elmer Gantry

programme.title: Wings
programme.desc: Two World War I pilots (Charles Buddy Rogers, Richard Arlen) woo a young woman (Clara Bow) and fight the Germans.

programme.title: Cliffhanger
programme.desc: This gripping action-adventure tale features Sylvester Stallone as a member of the Rocky Mountain Rescue Team, still grieving over his inability to prevent a friend from falling to her death.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Stephen King's A Good Marriage
programme.desc: With a serial killer on the loose and a stranger stalking her family, a dedicated wife unveils a sinister secret about her husband that threatens their marriage, and their lives.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw
programme.desc: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

programme.title: Hide And Seek
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman searching for his missing brother is drawn into a dark underworld that threatens his sanity and his family.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story about a single father and his young son. Finding themselves homeless, he risks everything on an unpaid internship in a highly competitive stockbroker training program, where only one in twenty interns make the grade.

programme.title: Undisputed
programme.desc: When the world's heavyweight champion is sent to prison, everything points to an inevitable showdown with the penitentiary's undefeated champ. But to make sure the meeting will happen, a former mob boss must call in favors from the outside world.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: In this explosive third installment of the blockbuster martial arts series, when a band of brutal gangsters led by crooked property developer (Mike Tyson) make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: IP Man 4: The Finale
programme.desc: Set during the Korean War, a band of prisoners at a POW camp find distraction from the hardships of war and a new sense of freedom in dancing.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: A comedy about a stunt man who’s never successfully landed a jump without wiping out and his attempt to master the biggest stunt of his life.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Jack Black is more hilarious than ever as Ignacio, a monastery cook who feeds orphan children by day and by night transforms himself into Nacho Libre, a notorious Luchador in stretchy pants.

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: As the entire nation watches the presidential campaign hurtle towards Election Day, one soldier races to uncover the conspiracy behind it - a conspiracy that seeks to destroy democracy itself.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: Mitch joins a prosperous Memphis firm that affords Mitch and his wife an affluent lifestyle beyond their wildest dreams. But when FBI agents confront him with evidence of corruption and murder within the firm, Mitch sets out to find the truth.

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: A powerful, award-winning film about an inner-city junior high school teacher with a drug habit who forms an unlikely friendship with one of his students after she discovers his secret.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Brimstone
programme.desc: A triumphant thriller set in the menacing inferno of the old American West, Brimstone tells the story of Liz, a genuine survivor who is hunted by a vengeful Preacher for a crime she didn’t commit.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: The Host (2013)
programme.desc: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

programme.title: Flyboys
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of the legendary Lafayette Escadrille, this action-packed epic tells the tale of America’s first fighter pilots.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: The Great Raid
programme.desc: As World War II rages, the elite 6th Ranger Battalion is given a mission of heroic proportions: push 30 miles behind enemy lines and liberate over 500 American prisoners of war.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Fall Of The House Of Usher (1960)
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman's suitor arrives to ask her hand in marriage, the doors of the mysterious house of Usher fling open...and terror begins.

programme.title: Barbarella
programme.desc: The setting is the planet Lythion in the year 40,000, when Barbarella makes a forced landing while traveling through space. She vanquishes evil in the forms of robots and monsters. She also rewards the handsome men who assist her in the adventure.

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: The Beast With A Million Eyes
programme.desc: An unspeakable horror! Extraterrestrial terror is on the hunt for human flesh in this horrifying tale of invasion! This is a 1950s creature-feature with some serious sociological bite! Paul Birch, Lorna Thayer, and Richard Sargent star!

programme.title: Hell House LLC.
programme.desc: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

programme.title: Hellraiser
programme.desc: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

programme.title: Hellraiser II: Hellbound
programme.desc: Kirsty is brought to an institution after the horrible events of Hellraiser (1987), where the occult-obsessive head doctor resurrects Julia and unleashes the Cenobites and their demonic underworld.

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When policeman Truman Gates' younger brother is murdered by the mob, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: The January Man
programme.desc: A killer comedy that has an ex-cop trailing a serial murderer... and the mayor's sexy daughter! Kevin Kline leads an all-star cast that includes Susan Sarandon, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Harvey Keitel and Rod Steiger.

programme.title: Miami Blues
programme.desc: An ex-con (Alec Baldwin) tiptoes on the borderline of psychotic behavior, playing cops and robbers on both sides of the law. He robs and kills one minute and poses as a cop the next in this thriller with a comic edge.

programme.title: The Phantom

programme.title: Gemini Man

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness

programme.title: IP Man 4: The Finale

programme.title: Shadow

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins

programme.title: Nacho Libre

programme.title: Click

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off

programme.title: Terms of Endearment

programme.title: Pretty In Pink

programme.title: Best Men

programme.title: The Firm

programme.title: Side Effects

programme.title: Half Nelson

programme.title: Minari

programme.title: Brimstone

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan

programme.title: Wings
programme.desc: Two World War I pilots (Charles Buddy Rogers, Richard Arlen) woo a young woman (Clara Bow) and fight the Germans.

programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: Three World War II veterans return home to small-town America to discover that they and their families have been irreparably changed.

programme.title: Marty
programme.desc: Ernest Borgnine won a Best Actor Oscar for his role as a Bronx butcher who gives up on love, until he meets an equally lonely school teacher in this charming story that garnered a total of four Oscars including Best Picture.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor Admiral James Greer becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Soul Survivors
programme.desc: Following a horrible car accident, a beautiful college freshman finds herself trapped in a twilight world somewhere between life and death in this haunting supernatural thriller.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

programme.title: Hide And Seek
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman searching for his missing brother is drawn into a dark underworld that threatens his sanity and his family.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story about a single father and his young son. Finding themselves homeless, he risks everything on an unpaid internship in a highly competitive stockbroker training program, where only one in twenty interns make the grade.

programme.title: Undisputed
programme.desc: When the world's heavyweight champion is sent to prison, everything points to an inevitable showdown with the penitentiary's undefeated champ. But to make sure the meeting will happen, a former mob boss must call in favors from the outside world.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: In 1905, revolutionist Sun Yat-Sen visits Hong Kong to discuss plans with Tongmenghui members to overthrow the Qing dynasty. But when they find out that assassins have been sent to kill him, they assemble a group of protectors to prevent any attacks.

programme.title: Iron Monkey
programme.desc: Presented by Quentin Tarantino, Iron Monkey is the spirited tale of a mysterious and mythical Chinese legend in this exhilarating non-stop martial arts excitement.

programme.title: True Legend
programme.desc: Su Qi-Er retired from his life as a renowned Qing dynasty general in order to pursue his dream of a family and his own martial arts school.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind, or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Jack Black is more hilarious than ever as Ignacio, a monastery cook who feeds orphan children by day and by night transforms himself into Nacho Libre, a notorious Luchador in stretchy pants.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: When Shelley gets kicked out of the mansion, she's lost in the wilds of Beverly Hills until she stumbles upon the sorriest sorority on campus. Now it's up to her to spruce up the girls and heat up the Zeta house before the University shuts them down.

programme.title: Best Men
programme.desc: Drew Barrymore, Luke Wilson and Sean Patrick Flannery star in this hilarious action-comedy wherein Drew Barrymore is a young woman determined to have the perfect wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob the local bank.

programme.title: Strictly Ballroom
programme.desc: A championship ballroom dancer finds inspiration within, and decides he'll stop at nothing to win, even if it means rewriting the rules. A worldwide feel-good hit, with an incredible soundtrack, from director Baz Luhrmann (MOULIN ROUGE!).

programme.title: Autumn In New York
programme.desc: Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: As the entire nation watches the presidential campaign hurtle towards Election Day, one soldier races to uncover the conspiracy behind it - a conspiracy that seeks to destroy democracy itself.

programme.title: Identity
programme.desc: What if every choice we ever make was already made for us? What if there really were no coincidences in life and our destinies were already predetermined? Ten strangers with secrets are brought together in a savage rainstorm. Rated: R

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: REVOLVER is populated with Guy Ritchie's (Snatch; Lock, Stock & Two Smoking Barrels) classic breed of fast-talking, sharp-suited gangsters but with a psychological twist that your mind may not be able to handle.

programme.title: Minari
programme.desc: A tender and sweeping story about what roots us, Minari follows a Korean-American family that moves to an Arkansas farm in search of their own American Dream.

programme.title: Girl, Interrupted
programme.desc: Winona Ryder and Academy Award(r)-winner Angelina Jolie are the certifiable stars of Claymoore Hospital's South Bell ward in this wry adaptation of Susanna Kaysen's best-selling memoir.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: A woman asks her ex-lover for help in order to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: Amityville 3-D
programme.desc: A reporter moves into the ominous Long Island house to debunk it of the recent supernatural events but is instead besieged by the evil manifestations of a demon-from-hell lurking in the basement.

programme.title: Night of the Comet
programme.desc: A huge comet passes near the earth, vaporizing nearly the whole planet. But a few partially exposed people are now blood-thirsty zombies, and they begin a hunt for the remaining humans.

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: Hellraiser: Revelations
programme.desc: A pair of buddies on a mission to get laid over spring break unwitting release the demon Pinhead who creates havoc. This is the ninth film in the horror franchise.

programme.title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer: 30th Anniversary Edition
programme.desc: A seemingly mild-mannered drifter introduces an ex-con and his innocent sister into his world of cold-blooded killing in this shocking and thought-provoking plunge into the mind of a murderer.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: Following a mysterious disappearance on a jump, a group of skydivers experience paranormal occurrences that leave them fighting for their lives.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When policeman Truman Gates' younger brother is murdered by the mob, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Uncut Gems
programme.desc: A charismatic jeweler (Adam Sandler) makes a high-stakes bet that could lead to the windfall of a lifetime.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: 1930's New York. The black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. If the seeds of Harlem's urban power would not grow in the White city, the Black underground would form to take control.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: Face/Off
programme.desc: As a result of a new medical technique, an agent is able to surgically take on the identical appearance of a criminal in order to take down his terrorist organization.

programme.title: The Big Hit
programme.desc: Lou Diamond Phillips, Mark Wahlberg, Christina Applegate, Antonio Sabato Jr. and Lela Rochon star in this story of a hitman who kidnaps the teenage child of his boss.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: The Return Of A Man Called Horse
programme.desc: Richard Harris stars in this superior sequel which follows the plight of a horribly wronged tribe of Sioux Indians and the white man who would join in their revenge.

programme.title: Rio Lobo
programme.desc: This fifth and final collaboration between John Wayne and director Howard Hawks is an action-filled Western set after the Civil War, in which a group of men seek out Union traitors responsible for a string of train robbers.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: When a couple of young astronomers discover an enormous comet on course to collide with Earth, the countdown to doomsday begins, and the human race embarks on the fight for survival.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Camino a la libertad

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Las fiestas son geniales, siempre y cuando tu familia no te obligue a tener una. Pero podría ser peor: que el cumpleañero llegue cuando ya se fueron todos, o que nadie se acuerde de tu cumpleaños.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Crees que te ha ido mal en las fiestas? Pues no has visto nada aún. Desde casarte con la amiga fea, a vacilar con un psicópata. No te pierdas de este episodio para reírte de lo que te hizo llorar en algún momento.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Siempre podrás disfrutar de las fabulosas cenas navideñas en familia y las despedidas de solteros. Por lo menos en esas fiestas no necesitas encontrar una chica que te pare bola.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Si la diversión sería hacer cosas responsables y tediosas, tal vez nos evitaríamos tantas malas pasadas en las fiestas. Menos mal que nos parece divertido todo lo que nos hace daño, y podemos reírnos de eso en este episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Necesitas una excusa para beber? En este episodio te daremos 5 buenas razones para borrar el cassette. Brinda con nosotros y recuerda, nunca es tarde para traumarse y volverse alcohólico.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Para animar una fiesta no necesitas buenos amigos, buena comida ni grandes conversaciones trascendentales. Lo único que necesitas es trago barato de dudosa reputación.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Quieres saber qué tipo de borracho eres? Rápido, mira este episodio y se te revelará el resultado al fondo de tu copa. Y si no te identificas es porque con nosotros no has tomado.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Ningún festejo en Latinoamérica esta completo sin cantidades ridículas de trago. Desde tu primera fiesta hasta las navidades en familia. Y lo seguimos consumiendo incluso cuando todos hemos dicho "nunca más volveré a tomar".

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Un episodio que lo tiene todo: romance, tragedia, suspenso, el verdadero significado de la navidad, mucho alcohol y al Chichico en pelotas. Brinda con nosotros y descubre cómo sobrevivir a una fiesta de oficina.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Beans rompe su taza de té favorita, y se dirige a un lugar especial para encontrar otra taza de ese tipo. Allí luchará contra un pequeño canino que se ha robado a Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Hurgando en un viejo baúl en el ático de Mrs Wicket, Mr Bean nos transporta a su juventud. Allí nos develará cuando conoció a su fiel amigo Teddy y cuando aprendió a manejar su mini cooper. Su pasado fue lo que lo convirtió en el hombre que es ahora.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean adopta un misterioso animal rosado perdido. ¿Qué es esta cosa rosa y de dónde vino? Ninguna enciclopedia parece resolver el misterio sobre la identidad de la criatura. Mr Bean deberá insistir hasta encontrar una respuesta.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Irma Gobb tendrá una cena romántica junto a Mr. Bean, pero el no está del todo preparado. Al quedarse dormido en el baño mientras el pollo se cocina en el horno, Mr Bean debe ingeniárselas para tener lista la cena. Un invitado sorpresa tiene la solución.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Una pelota de tenis se atranca en una tubería de drenaje en la azotea. ¿De cuántas maneras diferentes puede Bean intentar recuperarla? Su único problema es el miedo a las alturas.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean muerde un pedazo de palomitas de maíz, lo que le causa mucho dolor. Él piensa que al sacar su diente doloroso, resolverá sus problemas. Quitársela el mismo parece no dar solución y por eso deberá ir al dentista

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean salva a un gatito de un árbol. La prensa y el dueño del gatito llegan a su puerta para tomar una fotografía, pero el cabello de Bean está desordenado, por lo que decide cortarse el pelo."

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean quiere ver un programa en la televisión, pero los vecinos no mantendrán el ruido bajo. No hay lugar en su casa para escapar de tan odioso sonido. Bean comienza a tener pensamientos de venganza.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de un infortunado accidente, Mr Bean debe reemplazar al gato tuerto de su vecina. Sin embargo en sus reiterados intentos por limpiar el salón, Bean no encuentra manera de controlar al gato.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Ir a la tienda por provisiones se convierte en una pesadilla cuando una interminable lista de compras y un carrito aplastado con una rueda torcida conspiran para arruinar su día. Por lo que Mr. Bean decide construir un súper carrito de supermercado.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean lleva a su casa una urraca herida y pronto se da cuenta de que le gusta coleccionar cosas brillantes que toma de las casas vecinas. Pero adivinen quién tiene la culpa...

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr.Bean imagina que está surfeando en Hawái, pero es interrumpido por su vecina. Por eso decide surfear por las escaleras en una tabla de planchar, lo que tiene consecuencias peligrosas. Con la Sra. Wicket en el hospital, Bean deberá cuidar de su gato

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean pierde su barco embotellado, que queda atrapado en el camión del lechero. Lo busca de manera frenética, solo para verlo desaparecer en la lechería local, entre otras botellas. Una misión imposible.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Con Teddy en la tintorería, Mr Bean se siente solo. Por fortuna, aparece un pez dorado en el estanque del jardín. Bean se divierte mucho con su nuevo amigo hasta que, en la playa, descubre que algunos peces son gigantescos y tienen grandes dientes.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Durante una visita a la Galería Nacional de Londres, Mr Bean es testigo del robo de una importante obra de arte. Sabueso que es, persigue al culpable a través del Canal hacia París. Le esperan muchos obstáculos.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Heidi: El fantasma

programme.title: Heidi: De regreso en Dörfli

programme.desc: Boruto está furioso de que Kawaki haya roto la vasija que si hermanita hizo para su mamá, avivando la rivalidad entre ellos. Como otro portador del Karma, Kawaki le hace una propuesta.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Kawaki va al pueblo con Naruto para comprar una vasija nueva y reemplazar la que rompió. En el camino a la Tienda de Flores Yamanaka, Sarada se les une.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Kawaki observa un combate Shinobi cuerpo a cuerpo entre Naruto y Boruto. Boruto utiliza su especialidad, el Jutsu clones de sombra, para enfrentarse a su padre, pero tiene dificultades.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Para controlar mejor sus Karmas, Boruto y Kawaki deciden entrenar en condiciones más realistas. Mientras Naruto y Himawari observan, activan sus Karmas y se enfrentan.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Delta entra a la fuerza a la Aldea de la Hoja para recuperar a Kawaki y se presenta ante Boruto y los demás.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: Delta utiliza su rayo destructor que puede neutralizar cualquier poder regenerativo. Indomable, Naruto lo suprime a la fuerza con un Rasengan Gigante.

programme.title: Bakugan: El Surgimiento de Mechtanium
programme.desc: Los peleadores regresaron a la Tierra y están peleando dentro del expandido y asombroso interespacio de Bakugan. Con la llegada de nuevos participantes, no faltan peleadores para el número uno, Dan, quien se ve desafiado en cada turno.

programme.title: Bakugan: El Surgimiento de Mechtanium
programme.desc: Dan y Drago comienzan un régimen de entrenamiento riguroso al mismo tiempo que intentan poner bajo control los nuevos poderes de Drago.

programme.title: Bakugan: El Surgimiento de Mechtanium
programme.desc: Dan y Drago siguen intentando entender la relación entre el código de poderes de Eve y el nacimiento de Mectogan, Zenthon. Al mismo tiempo, su popularidad en el interespacio de Bakugan disminuye.

programme.title: Heidi: La estatua rota
programme.desc: Heidi y el abuelo se mudan a la mansión para que Heidi pueda continuar sus estudios. Los Keller se enojan por esta situación y se niegan a venderle suministros al abuelo.

programme.title: Heidi: El prendedor
programme.desc: Pedro y su abuela no tienen suficiente dinero, Heidi encuentra el broche de su abuela, una reliquia que los puede ayudar a salir de este problema.

programme.title: Heidi: Prueba escolar
programme.desc: El profesor organizar una prueba para finalizar el periodo, Theresa esta celosa de que Heidi esta ayudando a Pedro a ser buen estudiante, en venganza abre el recinto de las cabras para que Pedro no pueda llegar a la prueba a tiempo.

programme.title: Heidi: La búsqueda del tesoro
programme.desc: El Sr Traber se mudará a otra ciudad pero se lleva consigo a Karl, Theresa tiene sentimientos por él. Heidi la empujara a que confiese sus sentimientos por el antes de que se vaya.

programme.title: Heidi: La hora de las cabras
programme.desc: Por fin llega Clara y la señorita Rottenmeier a visitar a Heidi, Clara y Heidi quieren pasar el mayor tiempo juntas por lo que deben convencer a la señorita Rottenmeier de que vivan juntos en las cabañas en la montaña.

programme.title: Heidi: La tormenta
programme.desc: Todos están viviendo en la cabaña, un día de tormenta la señorita Rottenmeier se pierde entre las montañas, todos se preocupan por ella y salen a su búsqueda, sin pensar que la señorita Rottemeier regresará a salvo.

programme.title: Heidi: El puente del diablo
programme.desc: El abuelo tiene que terminar de construir el puente, pero siempre se queda congelado pensando en el accidente que tuvo Tobias, este hecho no lo deja continuar, por lo que Heidi y Clara investigarán para apoyar al abuelo y que pueda superar este trauma.

programme.title: Heidi: Friedrich
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier se encuentra a su ex pareja Friedrich, negando aceptar su pasado quiere salir huyendo para Frankfurt, Clara se niega a irse y se esconde lo cual obliga a la señorita Rottenmeier a pedirle ayuda a Friedrich.

programme.title: Heidi: La silla de ruedas
programme.desc: Pedro esta celoso de que Heidi pasa mayor tiempo con Clara, se enfurece cuando se da cuenta que Heidi e enseña la casa del árbol a Clara.

programme.title: Heidi: Los amigos perdonan
programme.desc: Pedro y Clara se piden disculpas mutuamente por los celos y robarse la atención de Heidi, ambos aclaran la situación deciden realizar un nuevo juramento de amistad acompañados de Heidi en la casa del árbol.

programme.title: Naruto: El propósito del estratega

programme.title: Naruto: La muerte de Naruto

programme.title: Naruto: Cuando el tiempo se detuvo

programme.title: Naruto: Cuando Las Garzas Extendieron Sus Alas

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel salen a pasear y deciden entrar en una tienda de ropa, pero una serie de hechos desafortunados hacen que Kenan acabe perdiendo su camisa y su pantalón. Como resultado, Kenan queda atrapado en la tienda en ropa interior.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Chris se va de vacaciones y deja a Kenan y Kel a cargo de su casa por unos días. Parece que todo está bajo control, sin embargo las cosas empiezan a ir terriblemente mal ¡cuando se olvidan de cuidar la casa!

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan se convierte en un héroe cuando captura a un peligroso criminal en la tienda de comestibles Rigby's. Cuando el criminal escapa de la prisión, decide ir a la casa de Kenan para vengarse.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡El almirante de la Marina, Aokiji! La ferocidad de un puntal definitivo
programme.desc: Los Sombrero de Paja se encuentra con uno de los oficiales más poderosos de la Marina, uno de los almirantes: Aokiji. A pesar de insistir en que no tiene intenciones hostiles, Aokiji cambia de opinión y decide capturar a los Sombrero de Paja.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡Un duelo entre la goma y el hielo! Luffy contra Aokiji
programme.desc: Tras congelar a Robin, Aokiji se enfrenta a Luffy, quien intenta distraer al almirante de la Marina para que los demás Sombrero de Paja escapen. A pesar de esto, Aokiji demuestra ser un enemigo demasiado poderoso para Luffy.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: El veloz tren marino y la ciudad del agua, Water Seven
programme.desc: Siguiendo a una rana que nada a crol, los Sombrero de Paja se topan con una estación de tren en el medio del mar. Ahí conocen a una extraña anciana que les cuenta sobre el tren marino y sobre el próximo destino que marca el Log Pose: Water Seven.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡Aventuras en la ciudad del agua! Rumbo a la enorme planta de construcción naval
programme.desc: Tras un breve recorrido por la maravillosa ciudad de agua, Luffy, Nami y Usopp llegan al astillero, donde los artesanos acaban de derrotar a unos piratas que no querían pagar la reparación de su barco. Mientras tanto, Robin y Chopper salen de compras.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: La familia Franky e Iceberg-san
programme.desc: Luego de cambiar el oro por dinero en efectivo, Luffy, Nami y Usopp van al astillero para ver a Iceberg-san y que presupuesten el arreglo del barco. Mientras tanto, unos ladrones atacan al Going Merry, donde solo se encuentra Zoro.

programme.title: One Piece - Water 7 Saga: ¡Galley-La Company! Un gran espectáculo en el Muelle 1

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Dog, el cazarrecompensas

programme.title: Cazador de homicidas

programme.title: Cazador de homicidas

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Mello irrumpe en el cuartel de SPK para recuperar una foto suya y asegurarse de no ser asesinado por Kira, a cambio de que Near le regrese la foto, Mello le cuenta una pista importante sobre los Death Notes: algunas de las reglas son falsas.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: La locutora de noticias estrella Kiyomi Takada se convierte en la vocera mundial de Kira, ella fue novia de Light en el colegio. Las sospechas de Aizawa sobre Light van en aumento.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light pretende investigar a Kiyomi, pero mientras los integrantes del cuerpo especial escuchan por el micrófono, Light pasa notas a Kiyomi pidiéndole que ayude a Kira en su misión de cambiar al mundo, ella accede.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Aizawa se da cuenta de lo que está sucediendo y avisa a Near, quien ya sabia acerca de las notas, Near pide a Aizawa que continúe vigilando a Light y pone en acción un plan para separarlo de Misa.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light le da Kiyomi la orden de acabar con Near, justo cuando él piensa que todo va de acuerdo a lo planeado Kiyomi es secuestrada.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Según el acuerdo, Near se encuentra con el SPK en un almacén y, para sorpresa de todos, Near revela que el seguidor de Kira, Mikami, está en el almacén y escribe el nombre de todos en el Death Note.

programme.title: Arcade Fire: Live at Coachella
programme.desc: Arcade Fire se presenta en el Festival de Música de Coachella Valley.

programme.title: Other Voices
programme.desc: Un cartel repleto de talento británico e irlandés con Yard Act, Sans Soucis, the Joy Formidable, Cerys Hafana, Susan O'Neill, Colm Mac Con Iomaire, King Creosote y Adwaith. En la Iglesia de Santa María en la hermosa ciudad de Cardigan.

programme.title: Life In Six Strings
programme.desc: La cantante y guitarrista Grace Potter recibe a Kylie en su casa en Vermont para hablar sobre cine, de componer canciones, y cómo un viaje por carretera la llevó a un camino de autodescubrimiento. Kylie aprende el arte de la técnica "slide".

programme.title: Memory Lane
programme.desc: Esta es una serie que mira tanto hacia atrás como hacia adelante a partir de las presentaciones en vivo, señalando la evolución de un artista. Las canciones representan tanto sus vidas como su trabajo y crean el marco para una película biográfica.

programme.title: New Order: Live at Finsbury Park
programme.desc: En un festival al aire libre filmado en vivo en el Parque Finsbury de Londres, la banda actúa ante miles de personas, incluyendo a celebridades como Sofia Coppola y Pet Shop Boys.

programme.title: Dios de la Guerra
programme.desc: En 1557 los piratas se hacen con el control de Cengang en Zhejiang. Tras meses de intentonas futiles, el comandante Yu logra derrotarlos bajo el mando del recien ascendido General Qi. Sin embargo, los piratas logran escapar.

programme.title: El Juez Arquero
programme.desc: Un artista marcial, conocido por su habilidad con el arco, ayuda a una mujer a vengar la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: La Cacería
programme.desc: Un rastreador forma equipo con un agente del FBI para dar caza a un asesino entrenado. Con precisión y habilidad, el depredador va un paso por delante y escapa a la ciudad.

programme.title: Una chica en apuros
programme.desc: Surgen complicaciones románticas cuando una estudiante se hace pasar por su hermano gemelo y lo sustituye en su internado.

programme.title: The cobbler
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de un zapatero que tiene la peculiar habilidad de asumir la vida de sus clientes a través de los zapatos que repara.

programme.title: Love & Other Drugs
programme.desc: Maggie y Jamie comienzan una relación que los enfrenta a una enfermedad y a la droga del amor.

programme.title: La Última Pieza
programme.desc: Paula organiza una fiesta para su hermano. Al decorar con dinosaurios, nota que falta una pieza. Para recuperarla, enfrenta al dueño de una juguetería.

programme.title: Underworld
programme.desc: Selene, una guerrera vampiro, está inmersa en un conflicto entre vampiros y hombres lobo, mientras se enamora de Michael, un humano que es buscado por hombres lobo por razones desconocidas.

programme.title: Heredero
programme.desc: Cuando un joven cae enfermo por una misteriosa enfermedad, su madre tendrá que decidir hasta dónde está dispuesta a llegar para protegerle de unas aterradoras fuerzas que estuvieron presentes en su vida pasada.

programme.title: Pacto con el Diablo
programme.desc: En 1665, tras la muerte de su esposo, Grace Haverstock es injustamente acusada de brujería. Detenida por el inquisidor John Moorcroft, soporta torturas mientras lucha por su cordura y su inocencia.

programme.title: Por Siempre te Amare
programme.desc: Riley y Chris, recién graduados de la preparatoria y enamorados, se ven separados por un trágico accidente automovilístico. Mientras Riley se culpa por la muerte de Chris, él queda atrapado en un limbo.

programme.title: North Hollywood
programme.desc: Un niño debe decidir entre elegir el futuro que quiere su padre o seguir su sueño de convertirse en patinador profesional.

programme.title: Stano
programme.desc: Después de haber cumplido una pena de prisión de 17 años por un violento error que cometió en su juventud, un exjugador de béisbol regresa a su barrio en el Bronx.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: El asesino de "Magia Negra" anda suelto, asesinando bailarinas que encajan misteriosamente con la descripción de la nueva policía Sarah Montgomery.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Con el asesino aparentemente atrapado, el equipo cree que el caso está cerrado, cuando encuentran a otra mujer muerta que coincide con el m.o. del asesino en serie. Sarah, sin saberlo, se convierte en el objetivo del verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane y su equipo SIU corren para encontrar al distribuidor de una píldora tóxica "E" que aumenta el número de muertos en Seattle y hace que el miembro temporal de SIU, Gates, se meta en una situación de vida o muerte.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: La investigación "E" se lleva a cabo sin problemas hasta que el principal jefe de Seattle P.D. ordenó a Kane que actuara como seguridad para un excéntrico documentalista.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: El equipo de Kane se enfrenta a la Nación Arian "Nueva Esperanza" ya que trabajan para influir en el voto del público en las elecciones municipales.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane, después de lidiar con su propio estrés de posguerra, está llamado a ayudar a su compañero de guerra (Ryan Robbins) mientras sufre de P.T.S.

programme.title: El Inmortal: Ríos de Sangre
programme.desc: En 1936, los Wollners, una familia de inmigrantes alemanes que vivían en Town Creek (Maryland), recibieron instrucciones del Tercer Reich para hacer de anfitriones del Profesor Richard Wirth. La familia, que necesitaba dinero, aceptó la propuesta.

programme.title: La Hora de la Verdad
programme.desc: El plan de los tres ladrones lo tiene todo para salir adelante -secuestrar al nieto de un millonario y ganar dinero fácil- pero no contaban con el carisma del bebé, lo que enternece el corazón del trío y dificulta la tarea.

programme.title: Mátalos Suavemente
programme.desc: Cuando el criminal Johnny Amato idea un plan para robar en un juego de cartas organizado por el mafioso Markie, él elige a un ladrón llamado Frankie para hacer el trabajo.

programme.title: THE PERFECT GAME
programme.desc: Basado en una historia real. En 1957, un grupo de niños pobres de Monterrey, México, conmocionó al mundo al ganar 13 juegos seguidos y la Serie Mundial de Pequeñas Ligas en el único juego perfecto jamás lanzado en el Campeonato.

programme.title: Una prueba de fe
programme.desc: John y Alexa Taylor parecen tener la vida perfecta. Son la envidia de todos los padres de la ciudad. Su hijo Beau es la estrella del fútbol de la escuela y su hija Ravyn es la estudiante número uno.

programme.title: Una Prueba de Fe 2 - Volviendo a Casa
programme.desc: La familia Taylor se enfrenta a muchos problemas. Alexa cuida de su madre enferma de Alzheimer, Beau ha perdido su trabajo en el fútbol y Ravyn necesita ayuda con su matrimonio. Con el apoyo de sus amigos y de la fe, intentan salir adelante.

programme.title: Nueva en la ciudad
